framing.decision: Before relying on a dynaflows change, flag each repository whose setup or agent interaction it reaches, so the change is reviewed or addressed for that repository first
framing.unit_of_judgment: one revision range of oh-mi-pi-config crossed with one repository record and its mode
framing.action: reversible: a flag asks for review; nothing is blocked
framing.costs: a miss (an impacting change relied on unreviewed) costs more than a false flag (an extra review)
framing.wiring: not wired into rails; integration owns the call site and the state builder

scoring.command: infisical run --projectId <dev project> --env dev -- omp -p --no-session --config <overlay> "run judge_batch over cases.jsonl"
scoring.runs: each case scored once; a two-case smoke run (EI001, EI004) preceded it and gave the same scores

impact.rule: P(impact) >= threshold flags the repository for review

escalation_band.between: escalate: the owner or a reviewing agent decides
escalation_band.fallback: owner or reviewing agent; not run on the cases, so cascade figures assume the fallback is right
escalation_band.chosen_on: dev only: the narrowest band with no dev positive at or below no_at_most and no dev negative at or above yes_at_least

minimums.reason: framing defaults; recall raised to 0.9 because a miss costs more

label_set.split: by unit (extension commit): the 8 units with the lowest sha256(head) are test
label_set.provenance: agent_reviewed: innovation-council first pass (blind to scores; innovation-challenger and experiment-peer labelled independently, the council reconciled), claude as final arbiter agreeing on all 84; owner may override

results.conservative: --conservative --repeats 5: no threshold qualifies (fewer than 50 dev cases per label)

calibration.reason: gates read raw scores; probabilities are not shown as confidence

test_misses.EI050: policy gap: suppressing judged rules when dynaflows is off; mode.runs already says minimal runs no judged rules, so T2 (judge as if applied today) can read it as no change
test_misses.EI082: model limit or clipped state: a refactor subject hides a prove() signature change

error_analysis.next_fix: clarify T2 for changes that create today's mode contract, then relabel EI049-EI051; owner to accept or fix

shortfalls: test recall 0.8 is below the 0.9 minimum at the shipped threshold and at 0.5
the dev-chosen escalation band misses 3 of 15 test positives
no owner review of labels yet
fallback judge for the band not measured
about 30 dev cases per label; grow to 50+ per label, especially minimal-mode positives, before ready

label_guide.change: Y1-Y5 table rewrapped as a list for the 100-column markdown limit after labelling; rule wording unchanged
